difficultyAxis: First step into relationships: a child entity carries a foreign-key attribute pointing at the parent, and the read scenarios require the reference to survive persistence. Light validation rules appear for the first time.
rationale: Two entities, one explicit relation (Book.authorId -> Author.id), create and read only, four scenarios. Adjacent to tier 1 it adds two visible things at once: a second entity and a declared validation rule. Nothing here requires update, delete or cross-entity invariants.
